purpose: Proposed 120-request development comparison; not formal acceptance and not executed.
prior_scope: Historical results remain unchanged; scores with a different System are not reused.
formal_holdout_status: NOT_OPENED_OR_MODIFIED; independent evaluator uses cases not used for development
english_identity: DEFERRED; existing English/mixed natural-language rows unchanged
case_set_status: DRAFT_FOR_USER_REVIEW; freeze hashes before any approved execution

decision_rules.scope: Development screening only; no auto-deployment or claims of population pass rates.
decision_rules.blocking_errors: Any confirmed invented measurements/execution/certification or reversal of an explicit fact blocks recommendation pending review; harmless wording variation is not a failure.
decision_rules.basic_checks: Nonthinking identity 4/4, JSON schema and values 2/2, scope 4/4; Thinking report 8/8 separately. No averaging away a confirmed blocking error.
decision_rules.comparison: Compare task completion and fact preservation per case against both original_base and v0.1.14. Echo reduction alone is insufficient. Small differences remain inconclusive.
decision_rules.training: At most one proposed Full after separate user authorization; do not tune against historical T021/T024 questions.
decision_rules.formal_acceptance: Separate independent evaluation under the final configuration; exposed cases are historical regression, not unseen acceptance.

json_schema_application: For json cases, forward the same response_format json_schema to all models; do not put the schema only into System.
tool_call_check_before_release: Verify actual tools/tool_choice and application execution capability; server auto-tool-choice flag alone does not establish tool use.
seed_policy: The same predeclared seeds are used across models for development only; everyday requests omit seed.
